Maldives visa from Pakistan: quick answer

Pakistani passport holders can get a visa on arrival in Maldives if they meet the entry conditions; some travellers apply online in advance. Processing time varies by embassy and season. The checklist has 5 documents, including valid passport, confirmed return ticket, confirmed hotel booking and travel declaration. AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS processes and follows up your Maldives visit visa from Blue Area, Islamabad; start with a free WhatsApp check. Final decision rests with the embassy.

Maldives visa FAQs

What documents do I need for a Maldives visa from Pakistan?

The main documents are: Valid Passport; Confirmed Return Ticket; Confirmed Hotel Booking; Travel Declaration (Imuga); Polio Certificate. The full checklist is on this page.

How much does a Maldives visa cost from Pakistan?

Embassy charges change often, so we don't publish them. Message us on WhatsApp and we confirm the current all-in cost for your case before you pay anything.

How long does Maldives visa processing take?

Varies by embassy and season. Processing can take longer in peak season.

Can AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS apply for my Maldives visa from Islamabad?

Yes. We process and follow up Maldives visit visa applications from our Blue Area office: document checklist, file preparation, submission and follow-up. We can also arrange flight reservations, hotel bookings and travel insurance. Message us on WhatsApp at 03152323811 for a free assessment. Final decision rests with the embassy.

Is the Maldives visa open for Pakistani passport holders?

Yes. We are handling Maldives applications for Pakistani passport holders from our Islamabad office (visa on arrival / e-visa). Rules can change at short notice, so message us on WhatsApp to confirm the current position before you book anything.
